FUNSD.name: FUNSD
FUNSD.provenance: Guillaume Jaume, Hazem Hajj, Jean-Philippe Thiran (ICDARW 2019), CRC Research / EPFL
FUNSD.label_semantics: Entity labels (header, question, answer, other), bounding boxes, word transcriptions, linking graph. NO fraud labels.

CASIA2.name: CASIA 2.0
CASIA2.provenance: NLPR CASIA (Dong et al., 2013); Masks by Pham et al. (2019); Repaired by SunnyHaze (2024)
CASIA2.license: Non-commercial academic research use only. Citation required.
CASIA2.label_semantics: Authentic (Au) vs Tampered (Tp) natural photographs. Ground truth masks represent spatial pixel forgery locations.

IDSpace.name: IDSpace
IDSpace.provenance: CactusLab (Hugging Face cactuslab/IDSpace), Model-Guided Synthetic Document Generator
IDSpace.label_semantics: Synthetic European IDs: positive (genuine synthetic), fraud_inpaint_and_rewrite, fraud_crop_and_replace.

Synthetic.name: Synthetic Data
Synthetic.provenance: Internal VeriProof Synthetic Certificate Generation Pipeline
Synthetic.label_semantics: Requires explicit synthetic labels: genuine_synthetic_certificate, tampered_grade, tampered_roll_number, forged_qr.

Neon_Derived.name: Neon-Derived Data
Neon_Derived.license: Proprietary VeriProof Enterprise Data / GDPR & DPDP Compliant
Neon_Derived.label_semantics: Cryptographic certificate records: hash, issuer_id, issuance_timestamp, revoked_status.
Neon_Derived.reason_not_ready: Schema inventory, issuer status, and audit aggregates exported. Full document registry extraction paused pending production certificate issuance (registered_documents has 0 rows).

unsuitable_datasets: IDSpace (European IDs only; low OCR diversity)
OCR_and_Layout_Analysis.reasoning: FUNSD provides bounding boxes, transcription, and key-value linking on noisy documents.

Low_Level_Image_Forensics.reasoning: CASIA2 offers pixel-level ground truth masks for splicing/copy-move. IDSpace offers inpaint and portrait replacement.

Cryptographic_Verification.reasoning: Public datasets do not contain VeriProof digital signatures, Merkle proofs, or issuer PKI keys.

Academic_Credential_Verification.reasoning: CRITICAL: Merging CASIA/IDSpace/FUNSD labels into a single 'document fraud' classifier is invalid due to label semantic drift.

data_leakage_risks.source_donor_leakage: In CASIA 2.0, tampered images are created by splicing authentic donor images. Donors and tampered derivatives MUST remain in the exact same train/val/test split to prevent memorization.
data_leakage_risks.document_template_leakage: In IDSpace and synthetic data, multiple documents share identical layout templates. All instances of a template must reside in one split.
data_leakage_risks.test_contamination: FUNSD has an official benchmark split (149 train, 50 test). The 50 test documents must NEVER be seen during feature extraction or tuning.
